title: Power Rankings: Boston clings to the top spot
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 12
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: It's the Celts' right to scoff at criticism of their depth, PG play and ability to (A) guard athletic swingmen and (B) score against zones. But facts is facts: Boston is playing only .500 ball, at 3-3, since winning in Detroit.

rankings.summaryHtml: Don't know that we can make him the favorite, but Byron Scott has a real shot in the race to coach the West All-Stars in New Orleans. Which can only count as more evidence that Chris Paul should be starting in that game.

rankings.summaryHtml: With the Suns' D'Antoni ineligible and Phil's Lakers banged up, New Orleans native Avery Johnson is suddenly the guy most likely to prevent B-Scott from coaching the West, at 15-4 since Dallas' worrying 12-8 start.
